correctNoteNewFact.fact: The traction motor receives power from the traction battery, which the vehicle charges by plugging into an external power source; this is beyond the asked braking-energy return and wheel-drive functions.

absoluteDifficulty.rationale: This requires specific knowledge of EV regenerative braking: in some battery-electric models the traction motor-generator can drive the wheels and return braking energy to the traction battery. A player familiar with EV systems is likely to recognize the motor-generator role; an adult outside that topic may know the motor drives wheels but is less likely to know that the same component can return energy during braking. The key is not selected by a generic management function; the battery stores energy, controller regulates flow/speed/torque, and charger handles incoming AC.
